prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on what you want (spray vs UV/tanning beds), your location in Columbus, and priorities (price, cleanliness, privacy, speed, product quality). I can recommend places, but it’s easiest if you tell me whether you want a spray tan or a UV bed and what neighborhood or ZIP code you’re near.

If you’re not sure, here’s a quick guide to choose the best salon and stay safe:

How to pick the best salon
- Type: choose spray (airbrush or booth) for safer, even color; UV beds if you prefer that look (note higher skin cancer/aging risk).
- Reviews: check recent Google and Yelp reviews for cleanliness, technician skill, and color consistency.
- Portfolio: ask to see before/after photos for your skin tone.
- Products and technique: for spray tans, ask what solution they use (organic, DHA %), and whether they offer leveling, bronzer, or express solutions.
- Certification: for spray tan techs, look for certification (e.g., network training or trade-school credentials).
- Hygiene & equipment: clean booths, fresh solution, up-to-date beds (if using UV), disposable undergarments for spray.
- Pricing & packages: many places give discounts for packages; ask about boosters or add-ons.
- Patch test: request a patch test if you have sensitive skin or allergies.

Safety tips
- For spray tans: exfoliate beforehand, avoid lotions/oils before application, follow aftercare directions (no showering for the recommended time).
- For UV tanning: limit frequency, disclose medications/skin conditions, use eye protection and follow recommended session times for your skin type.
- Consider a spray tan instead of UV tanning to avoid UV skin damage.

If you want, tell me:
- Spray tan or UV beds?
- Which neighborhood or ZIP code?
I’ll pull up current top-rated salons near you and give 3–5 tailored recommendations with addresses, hours, and what they’re best known for.
